content.short: Balus is a TON SocialFi app for creating, sharing, and trading content in one place: Create, Share, and Trade Content in One Stop.
content.description: Balus is a social content app connected to TON and Telegram. Its public page presents a feed for new, top, value, recent, and trade-oriented content, with wallet connection at the center of the experience. The product is best described as SocialFi because content sharing and trading activity are tied together. Create, Share, and Trade Content in One Stop.
